name: @activepieces/piece-hunter
description: Find, verify and manage professional email addresses at scale. Automate email discovery, validation, lead tracking, and campaign outreach with Hunter.io.

auth.description: You can obtain your API key from [Account Settings](https://hunter.io/dashboard)

add-recipients.name: add-recipients
add-recipients.description: Add one or multiple recipients to a campaign.

auth.description: You can obtain your API key from [Account Settings](https://hunter.io/dashboard)

emails.description: Email addresses to add as recipients. At least one email or lead ID is required.

auth.description: You can obtain your API key from [Account Settings](https://hunter.io/dashboard)

lead_ids.description: Select leads from your Hunter account to add as recipients.

aiMetadata.description: Adds one or more recipients to a Hunter campaign, identified either by raw email addresses, by existing lead IDs, or both. Use to enroll contacts into an outreach campaign once you have the campaign ID. Requires at least one valid email or lead ID (max 50 of each per call); not idempotent — each call appends recipients, though Hunter skips duplicates already in the campaign.

count-emails.name: count-emails
count-emails.description: Returns the number of email addresses found for a domain or company.

domain.description: Domain name to count addresses for (e.g., "stripe.com"). At least one of domain or company is required.

company.description: Company name to count addresses for (e.g., "Stripe"). At least one of domain or company is required.

auth.description: You can obtain your API key from [Account Settings](https://hunter.io/dashboard)

type.description: Count only "personal" or "generic" email addresses. Leave blank for both.

aiMetadata.description: Returns how many email addresses Hunter knows for a given domain or company, broken down by department and seniority, and optionally filtered to personal or generic addresses. Use to gauge coverage before running an email search or to estimate prospecting volume. Provide either a domain or a company name; this is a read-only lookup that consumes no credits and is idempotent.

create-lead.name: create-lead
create-lead.description: Create and store a lead record.

email.description: The email address of the lead.

company.description: Name of the company the lead is working in.

company_industry.description: Sector of the company (e.g. Finance, Technology, Education, etc.).

source.description: Origin where the lead was found.

auth.description: You can obtain your API key from [Account Settings](https://hunter.io/dashboard)

leads_list_id.description: Select which list to add the lead to; defaults to your most recent list.

leads_list_ids.description: Array of list IDs to add the lead to; defaults to your most recent list.

custom_attributes.description: Key/value map of any custom attributes, e.g. { "customer_id": "cus-1234abcd" }.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new lead record in the Hunter account with contact and company details, optionally assigning it to a leads list and setting custom attributes. Use to persist a prospect for later outreach or tracking. Not idempotent — each call creates a separate lead even with identical input.

delete-lead.name: delete-lead
delete-lead.description: Delete a specific lead record by ID.

auth.description: You can obtain your API key from [Account Settings](https://hunter.io/dashboard)

lead_id.description: Select the lead to delete from your Hunter account.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently deletes a single lead from the Hunter account by its lead ID. Use to remove a prospect that is no longer relevant. Requires the lead ID; idempotent in effect since re-deleting an already-removed lead leaves the account in the same state.

find-email.name: find-email
find-email.description: Retrieve/propose the most likely email for a person at a domain.

domain.description: Domain name to count addresses for (e.g., "stripe.com"). At least one of domain or company is required.

company.description: Company name to count addresses for (e.g., "Stripe"). At least one of domain or company is required.

full_name.description: The person's full name (if you can't supply both first and last name).

max_duration.description: How long Hunter should spend refining results (3-20, default 10).

aiMetadata.description: Finds the most likely professional email address for a named person at a given company, returning a confidence score and supporting sources. Use to discover an unknown contact email from a name plus an organization. Requires either a domain or a company name, plus either both first and last name or a full name; this is a read-only lookup and is idempotent for the same input.

get-lead.name: get-lead
get-lead.description: Retrieve details of a specific lead.

auth.description: You can obtain your API key from [Account Settings](https://hunter.io/dashboard)

lead_id.description: Select a lead from your Hunter account.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves the full record for a single lead by its lead ID, including contact, company, verification, and list details. Use to inspect a known lead before updating or acting on it. Requires the lead ID; read-only and idempotent.

search-leads.name: search-leads
search-leads.description: List and filter leads in the account.

auth.description: You can obtain your API key from [Account Settings](https://hunter.io/dashboard)

leads_list_id.description: Select which list to add the lead to; defaults to your most recent list.

email.description: Filter by email (use "*" for any, "~" for empty, or substring).

country_code.description: Filter by ISO 3166‑1 alpha‑2 country code.

auth.description: You can obtain your API key from [Account Settings](https://hunter.io/dashboard)

sending_status.description: Filter by sending status(es): clicked, opened, sent, pending, error, bounced, unsubscribed, replied, or "~" (unset).

verification_status.description: Filter by verification status(es): accept_all, disposable, invalid, unknown, valid, webmail, or "pending".

last_activity_at.description: Use "*" for any value or "~" for unset.

last_contacted_at.description: Use "*" for any value or "~" for unset.

custom_attributes.description: JSON object of slug→filterValue (use "*", "~", or substrings).

query.description: Search first_name, last_name or email containing this substring.

limit.description: Max leads to return (1-1000). Defaults to 20.

offset.description: Number of leads to skip (0-100000). Defaults to 0.

aiMetadata.description: Lists leads in the Hunter account, optionally narrowed by a wide set of filters (email, name, company, list, verification/sending status, activity dates, custom attributes, free-text query) with limit/offset paging; with no filters it returns all leads. Use to find leads matching criteria or to page through the account. Read-only and idempotent.

auth.description: You can obtain your API key from [Account Settings](https://hunter.io/dashboard)

lead_id.description: Select a lead from your Hunter account.

email.description: The email address of the lead.

company.description: Name of the company the lead is working in.

company_industry.description: Sector of the company (e.g. Finance, Technology, Education, etc.).

source.description: Origin where the lead was found.

auth.description: You can obtain your API key from [Account Settings](https://hunter.io/dashboard)

leads_list_id.description: Select which list to add the lead to; defaults to your most recent list.

leads_list_ids.description: Array of list IDs to add the lead to; defaults to your most recent list.

custom_attributes.description: Key/value map of any custom attributes, e.g. { "customer_id": "cus-1234abcd" }.

aiMetadata.description: Updates fields on an existing lead identified by its lead ID, overwriting only the provided contact, company, list, or custom-attribute values. Use to correct or enrich a known lead. Requires the lead ID and at least one field to change; idempotent since re-sending the same values yields the same final state.

verify-email.name: verify-email
verify-email.description: Check email deliverability and validation status.

email.description: The email address of the lead.

aiMetadata.description: Verifies a single email address against Hunter, returning deliverability status, a confidence score, and signals such as MX records, SMTP check, disposable/webmail flags, and accept-all. Use to validate an address before sending. Requires the email; read-only and idempotent, though verification may occasionally be reported as still in progress.

new-lead.name: new-lead
new-lead.description: Fires when a new lead is created.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new lead is created in the connected Hunter account, emitting that lead record. Polls the account leads list and detects entries by creation time.
